fn CalculateLoss(costPrice: Int, sellingPrice: Int) -> Int
  requires (costPrice >= 0)
  requires (sellingPrice >= 0)
  ensures ((not (costPrice > sellingPrice)) or (result == (costPrice - sellingPrice)))
  ensures ((not (costPrice <= sellingPrice)) or (result == 0))
  effects pure
  example (CalculateLoss(0, 0) == 0)
{
  0
}
